name: suggestion-card
title: Suggestion Card
description: An agent offers one person a next step, in a card only they see: items with optional ticks, the host's own buttons, a menu, a footnote, its outcomes and a compact row.

meta.whenToUse: An agent offering a next step the person may ignore: tasks from a chat, a draft, a follow-up.
meta.whenNotToUse: A risky action that waits for a decision (RequestCard), or a change already made (AgentEditBanner).
